title: Leech Lattice Construction Pathway via Lambda_C
main_result: Lambda_C carries exactly the discriminant data (E8/2E8 = O+(8,2)) that parametrizes the E8->Leech gluing. The 120 anisotropic cosets = 240 E8 roots/pm1 = the glue fibers in the standard Leech construction.

bridge.anisotropic_cosets_120: = 240 E8 roots / pm1 = Leech glue fibers
bridge.W_E6_acts_on: both Disc(Lambda_C) and the glue group

caveat: Lambda_C has rank 40, Leech rank 24. No direct lattice map. Connection is via discriminant module.
open_question: Is there an explicit rank-reduction (projection, quotient) from Lambda_C to Leech that makes the geometric chain constructive?
verdict: Leech construction pathway identified via Disc(Lambda_C) = E8/2E8 = glue group. The anisotropic 120-cosets of Lambda_C explicitly encode the Leech glue data.
